notes.title: Lizzie's Patch
notes.notes:
Fish enemies now collide with each other
Fish AI simplified to reduce lag

notes.title: Anglerfish balance patch
notes.notes:
Mariana Anglerfish spawn rate decreased
Movement speed increased

notes.title: Version 10.1: Language Localization Part 1
notes.notes:
French text
Chinese text

Player IFrame increased from .2s to .8s
Thick-horned Bubble child bubbles implode on contact
Sea slug spawnrate increased for Ponto Beach
Unique upgrade cards for each weapon
New common upgrade cards added

Cursor disappearing after pause screen on Level-up canvas bug fixed
Some SFX volume increased

notes.title: WRATH patch
notes.notes:
New reticles for different weapons
S mode turned off for Crab Hunt
Cursor locked within window during gameplay, unlocked at pause screen

notes.title: Chronmaster Patch
notes.notes: At Victory, player will receive medal before pressing the "Accept Medal" button

notes.title: Neon Bubble Patch
notes.notes:
Neon Bubble spread tightened
Neon Bubble burst Y axis adjusted

notes.title: Achievements Patch
notes.notes: Must complete Wave 11 on any level for weapons achievements.

notes.title: Master Shrimp achievement patch
notes.notes: Unlocking the last weapon will trigger the Master Shrimp achievement

notes.title: UI Changes
notes.notes:
Layering of Level-up Screen
Death Screen now shows your Difficulty

notes.title: Endless Patch
notes.notes: Endless Mode card does not disappear after one use now.

notes.title: Endless Mode Patch
notes.notes: Enemies do 10% more damage per Difficulty Level

notes.title: UI Update
notes.notes: When player dies or wins, the level name will show up in the Score line.

notes.title: Crab Hunt Bug Fix
notes.notes: Beating Crab Hunt no longer unlocks Australia

notes.title: Benthic Octopus Patch
notes.notes:
Benthic Octopus can no longer push bones on Whale Fall.
Benthic Octopus Size increased by 30%.
